name: usage-reporter
description: Shows the weekly limit reading and, once configured, POSTs it hourly to your HTTPS endpoint. Off by default.

enabled.title: Send reports
enabled.description: POST a new, fresh weekly usage reading each hour. Leave off until postUrl, accountId and postToken are set.

postUrl.title: Receiver URL
postUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the JSON report. No user:password in the URL.

accountId.title: Account ID
accountId.description: The site account UUID, used locally to identify the configured receiver account. It must match the account in postUrl.

postToken.title: Receiver token
postToken.description: Required account-specific bearer token for the receiver (Authorization header). Never a Claude credential.
